summary: stdout is a self-hostable infrastructure observability and monitoring platform built with Astro, providing network discovery, AI-assisted diagnostics, incident management, and a community knowledge base. It scans hosts and Docker stacks, ingests metrics, and uses LLMs to surface and explain issues. Operators interact through a web HUD and configure monitoring via a setup wizard.

nodes.title: Frontend
nodes.notes: Server-rendered Astro pages, layouts, and components for the HUD, dashboards, setup wizard, docs, and status pages

nodes.title: Backend
nodes.notes: Astro Node server with API endpoints and lib services for scanning, discovery, diagnostics, observatory/sentinel logic, and business rules

nodes.title: Database
nodes.notes: Local SQLite store with Drizzle schema and migrations for hosts, incidents, entities, skins, and audit data

nodes.title: Auth
nodes.notes: Password hashing, session middleware, RBAC, license validation, and API token management

nodes.title: Integrations
nodes.notes: External connectors for AI diagnosis, email/Slack notifications, ticketing, metrics ingestion, and CVE/Docker scanning

nodes.title: Infrastructure
nodes.notes: Containerized deployment with observatory monitoring stack and Python sentinel agents for watching and analysis
